_comment: Handgepflegt (Issue #99): Englischer 'Was ist neu'-Text für GENAU die Version im Feld 'version'. Der CHANGELOG ist nur deutsch und wird nicht maschinell übersetzt (Owner-Entscheidung) - dieser Text wird beim Release von Hand geschrieben, sinngemäß zum deutschen CHANGELOG-Abschnitt derselben Version. Der Generator (scripts/generate-whatsnew.mjs) übernimmt 'en' NUR, wenn 'version' hier exakt zur aktuellen APP_VERSION passt - sonst bleibt EN absichtlich leer, damit eine vergessene Übersetzung nicht lautlos durchrutscht (siehe web/scripts/check-whatsnew.mjs).
en:
No migration, no new features - this release closes security gaps in third-party libraries and locks down the image service. After deploying, the app looks exactly the same as before.

• Next.js updated from 14.2.5 to 14.2.35, closing 12 reported vulnerabilities in the previous version, including one rated critical (an authorization bypass in the middleware). It wasn't reachable in our setup - we don't use middleware - but it shipped in the library we used.
• The image service now only accepts our own image sources. Previously it could load any image URL (a potential open relay for third parties); now only the four sources we actually use are allowed: TCGdex, TCGplayer, the Pokedex placeholders and our own server. Every image in the app still loads unchanged.
• Pillow updated from 10.4.0 to 12.3.0 (backend image processing) - output is byte-for-byte identical to the previous version. The only difference: 16-bit grayscale PNGs are now accepted on upload instead of rejected.

• A misconfigured server address (one trailing slash too many) could have made all of your own card photos invisible - this is now caught before it happens.
• On mobile, closing the menu could leave the keyboard focus off the menu button.
